transport_policy: Parts are continuations. Missing catalog entries are not negative evidence.

obligations_to_time.requirement: Initialize notes before the entry uses the assembler's notes-backed assembly state.
obligations_to_time.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput writes a source file, calls read_begin, then calls perform_an_assembly_pass. That pass creates sections; alloc_seginfo stores section information in notes.
obligations_to_time.failure_condition: For an ordinary input that reaches section setup, the target has never executed the notes initialization relocated from read_begin to main.
